concerns.text: FR-010 mandates stratification by confinement mode (L/H) but lacks a minimum N per stratum. With total N=5-10, this risks subgroups with N<3 where correlation is undefined. The requirement needs a fallback clause (e.g., 'if N_stratum < 3, skip stratification and report global correlation with a warning') to ensure the requirement is always actionable and does not force a pipeline failure or mathematically invalid operation.
